Coordonnateur de projet / Project Coordinator

Entreprise: Groupe Rivière-Nord
Lieu: Gatineau, QC
Date limite: 30 novembre 2026

Description

Groupe Rivière-Nord is looking for a bilingual Project Coordinator to support delivery
teams across our Gatineau and Ottawa sites. Le poste est en mode hybride.

Responsibilities / Responsabilités

- Coordinate project schedules and track deliverables
- Support project management reporting for stakeholders
- Prepare bilingual status documentation

Work Term: Winter 2027
Duration: 4 months
Salary: $26.00 per hour
